主要内容: On February 24, 2016, Broadway Financial Corporation issued a press release announcing its results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2015. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The filing includes details about the company's financial performance and operations for the specified period. The press release provides an overview of the company's financial condition and results of operations, which are essential for investors and stakeholders to understand the company's performance. The filing is part of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The press release is a key document for assessing the company's financial health and operational performance.
